GOT QUESTIONS?

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about turnaround times, fabric care, pickup areas and billing.

We provide free doorstep pickup and delivery across all major sectors of Jodhpur, including Shastri Nagar, Ratanada, Paota, Sardarpura, Chopasni Housing Board, Old City (Makrana Mohalla, Clock Tower), Pal Road, and Mandore.
Standard wash & fold or wash & steam iron is delivered within 24 to 48 hours. Premium dry cleaning takes 48 to 72 hours. Need urgent laundry? Our 4-to-6 hour Express Service is available round the clock.
Yes, absolutely! We specialize in heirloom ethnic wear, zari embroidered sarees, bandhani, raw silk, and woolen blazers. Each delicate item receives specialized solvent pre-treatment, zero-spin gentle cycles, and protective hand steam pressing.
All garments are covered under our comprehensive Garment Protection Policy up to ₹20,000 per order. In the extremely unlikely event of damage or loss, we provide immediate fair compensation or hassle-free replacement.
Yes! Same-day express laundry is available with priority rider pickup. Simply book before 11:00 AM on WhatsApp or via our booking form, and receive your clothes fresh and pressed by evening.
We operate on a "Pay After Delivery" model. You can pay via Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, UPI QR code on the delivery bag, cash on delivery, or direct bank transfer.
